title: Attempt to make main repo mapping inverse more efficient

timeline.body: Not completely sold on this, btw. But it's the path of least resistance (regarding code changes).
This comment and the name make it sound as if this could be applied to any other repo, but the class is called `MainRepoMapping`. Maybe call it `CachedInverseRepoMapping` instead?

reply.body: fixed to just use an inline subclass instead

timeline.message:
Attempt to make main repo mapping inverse more efficient

During `bazel query`, `Label#getDisplayForm(mainRepoMapping)` might be called many many times. We can optimize for that case without sacrificing too much memory by computing a reverse mapping for the main repo mapping only.

Fixes https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/20613.

Closes https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/20617.
